insights.insight: [tension] PROVISIONAL (no client data yet). When someone in Almaty has lived for months with a gap or a failing bridge, they want to chew and smile without thinking about it, but they fear the surgery itself («это больно?», «сверлят кость»), so they postpone it or stay with a removable denture. We can show what actually happens, step by step, from the patient's side: the tray being laid out, sealed instruments, the doctor's close voice explaining each step. We never promise painlessness: «без боли» is rejected by the medical-ad rules (E02) and the anaesthesia protocol is a NEEDS FACT. This moves booked implant consultations because surgical anxiety is the hypothesised consideration bottleneck.
insights.tension: Wants a normal tooth back vs fears the operation (pain, «кость», the unknown chair experience)
insights.who_feels_it: Adults who have lost a tooth or have a failing bridge or denture and have postponed implants for months because of fear of the procedure
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: doctor's gloved hands laying out the tray, close-mic voice (≤30 cm, recorded separately in «тихий угол») narrating what happens at each step. No faces, no mouths, no drill close-ups. No claim about pain or anaesthesia until the doctor confirms the protocol, so this is recognition/explanation content only. «Нам пишут: „Это больно?“» is blocked until the export shows ≥2 real messages.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] PROVISIONAL. Before booking, a person considering implants wants to know what they are walking into, but they fear the first consultation is a sales trap («насчитают на миллион») and do not know what happens there, so they ask the price in chat and disappear when they hear «только на консультации». We can show the first visit as a sequence: what the doctor checks, what you leave with, and that you decide later. All steps are NEEDS FACT from the owner. Honest-signal content where the doctor says when they would advise waiting or another option (owner/doctor-confirmed only) separates us from the promo-led category (E23). This sits directly on the measured action, booking a consultation, so it has the highest leverage.
insights.tension: Wants a clear answer before committing vs fears being pressured into an expensive plan at the first visit
insights.who_feels_it: People who have asked a clinic for an implant price at least once and did not book because the next step felt like a commitment
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: the empty consultation desk, the jaw model in the doctor's hands, close-voice walkthrough of the visit (voice recorded in «тихий угол»). No imaging of real patients. The sequence, its duration and whether the consultation is free are NEEDS FACT, so until confirmed this is recognition content only («вот что обычно спрашивают на первом приёме»).

insights.insight: [friction] PROVISIONAL. When someone starts comparing implant clinics, they want a number to compare, but a private clinic cannot give one before an examination (and no prices are in the ledger: E01, E33), so price-first chats stall (hypothesis E10) and the person picks whoever posted an «от … ₸» promo. We can show what the price depends on: number of teeth, bone, imaging, crown type, framed as the doctor's opinion with no figures. The CTA promises only what staff can keep (e.g. explaining what the consultation includes), plus an agent-drafted WhatsApp reply that always gives a next step. This moves coded chats → bookings because it converts the dead-end price question into a booking question.
insights.tension: Wants a comparable price now vs a quote that honestly depends on an exam they haven't had
insights.who_feels_it: People messaging several Almaty clinics in the same week asking «сколько стоит имплант»
insights.content_reality: «тихий угол»: administrator's hands typing the reply on a phone (anonymised chat card in screen mode), plus the doctor's hands on the jaw model in «кабинет» pointing to each factor. No prices, no comparisons with other clinics. Fixing the WhatsApp reply script is a non-content fix flagged with this insight.

insights.insight: [proof] PROVISIONAL. When a patient sits in a surgical chair, they want to trust that everything entering their mouth is clean, but sterilisation happens behind a closed door («инструменты одноразовые?»), so they judge the clinic by the interior instead. We can film the real sterilisation ritual: pouches sealed, the steriliser cycle, a sealed pouch torn open on the tray. The camera verifies whatever is filmed. Before/after content is rejected here because it needs written consent (E02), and this is the honest proof that replaces it. It builds the trust that precedes booking an operation.
insights.tension: Wants certainty of safety vs cannot see what happens behind the door
insights.who_feels_it: People choosing a clinic for a surgical procedure who worry about hygiene and have no way to check it
insights.content_reality: «стерилизационная»: hands sealing pouches, steriliser door and beep, and in «кабинет» the crackle of a sealed pouch being opened at 20–30 cm. Verified only once filmed. Do not claim «одноразовое» or a sterilisation standard until the owner confirms (NEEDS FACT).

insights.insight: [myth] PROVISIONAL. When someone has been told «кости нет» or believes «мост проще» or «импланты — для пожилых», they want the simplest fix, but the belief closes the implant option before a doctor has looked, so they settle for a bridge or denture by default. A doctor can explain on a jaw model what the belief gets wrong and what it depends on, framed as the doctor's opinion («врач считает»), with no outcome promise and only after the responsible doctor signs off the wording. This moves consultations because a belief is the hidden reason some people never ask.
insights.tension: Wants the easy option vs a belief that rules out the better-fitting one without an exam
insights.who_feels_it: People who were once told implants are impossible or unnecessary for them, and older patients assuming it is not for their age
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: doctor's hands on the jaw model showing bone, bridge and implant positions, close voice. An AI explainer is allowed only for the invisible (bone inside the jaw) and must be labelled. There is no clinical proof on camera, so this is explanation and belief-check only, never «вам подойдёт».

insights.insight: [moment] PROVISIONAL. Right after a tooth is pulled, when a denture starts slipping, or before a family той or photos, the gap suddenly matters and the person wants to act, but does not know how long the path is («сколько ходить без зуба?»), so the urge fades and they wait for the next trigger. We can meet them at that moment with what to do in the first weeks after losing a tooth and what the steps are (sequence and timing are NEEDS FACT). We never promise «успеете к тою». This moves bookings because a moment is when consideration turns into a message.
insights.tension: Motivated right now vs the process looks long and uncertain, so the motivation decays
insights.who_feels_it: People who just had a tooth removed, whose denture or bridge just failed, or who have a family celebration ahead
insights.content_reality: «кабинет» / «тихий угол»: hands drawing a simple timeline on paper next to the jaw model, close voice. No dates or durations until the doctor confirms the typical sequence. Seasonal hooks (той season, New Year photos) are planned 10–14 days ahead.

insights.insight: [identity] WILDCARD, PROVISIONAL. When an adult child sees a parent struggling to chew with a removable denture, they want the parent to eat comfortably at the family table, but the parent says «мне уже не надо» and fears the operation, so nothing happens. The decision-maker and the patient are different people. We can speak to the child: what to ask the parent, and what a first consultation is (we can't see this yet, so it is recognition and explanation only). It creates a natural share line («скинь маме») and a second route into bookings.
insights.tension: Child wants the parent's comfort vs the parent's refusal and fear
insights.who_feels_it: Adult children in Almaty arranging and often paying for an older parent's dental treatment
insights.content_reality: «тихий угол»: hands only. A cup of tea and a plate of food on a family table plus the jaw model, close voice. No real patients or relatives on camera. Whether relatives make first contact is unverified, so this is recognition content only until the export shows who writes first.

insights.insight: [content_reality] WILDCARD, PROVISIONAL. Outsiders picture an implant as a big «винт в челюсти» from 3D animations (category convention E24), but almost nobody has held the real object. Showing the actual implant or a demo sample in gloved hands, next to an everyday object, is a curiosity gap that also quietly shrinks the fear («снаружи этого никто не видел»). Per E30, the object must answer a patient question («что вообще ставят?»), not be a bare product demo. It feeds reach and wildcard ideas; no brand or dimensions are named until confirmed.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity: «что это вообще такое и какого оно размера?» vs the scary mental image
insights.who_feels_it: Anyone who has heard «имплант» but never seen one, including people quietly afraid of it
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: a demo implant in gloved hands next to a familiar object, macro shot at 20–30 cm. Requires the owner to confirm a demo sample exists (NEEDS FACT). No brand label visible, no size numbers on screen.

insights.insight: [content_reality] WILDCARD, PROVISIONAL. Clinic sounds feed the fear: people hear a whine through the wall and imagine the worst. The quiet sounds of preparation are unseen rituals: a pouch tearing open, instruments placed on a tray, the steriliser beep. A «угадайте звук» or close-sound piece can decode what each sound is, which turns the clinic's soundscape from threat into routine. Using the drill sound as a pleasurable sensory loop is rejected because it is the fear trigger (E27). Honest risk: it may still remind viewers of the chair, so its prior stays low.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity about what the sounds are vs those sounds being the source of dread
insights.who_feels_it: People who feel anxious at the mere sound of a dental clinic
insights.content_reality: «стерилизационная» and «кабинет»: one continuous close-sound take (pouch, tray, steriliser) at 20–30 cm, no faces, no patients. Verified only after the reality scan confirms audio quality.

insights.insight: [price_value] PROVISIONAL. When someone sees «имплант от …» promos (E23) and then hears a higher quote, they want to believe the difference is real, but they cannot see what the price contains, so they assume overcharging or choose the cheapest ad. The «above average» positioning (E06) is only a self-description. We could show where the money goes (imaging, planning, sterile single-use kit, components) only after the owner confirms each element, and never as a price slide (E31). This defends booking conversion against promo competition without naming any clinic.
insights.tension: Wants value for a large spend vs suspects the higher price is just markup
insights.who_feels_it: People who have received a cheaper implant quote or seen promo ads and are deciding whether a pricier clinic is worth it
insights.content_reality: «стерилизационная» / «кабинет»: hands showing each component or step of the plan in order, close voice. Every element is NEEDS FACT from the owner. Without confirmation it stays unusable for claims and can only become a question prompt («что входит в цену имплантации — спросите у врача»).
